_doc: Phase 1 metrics snapshot for the pilot dashboard — US-074 (SFB↔GitHub sync health) and US-078 (per-flow metrics + key-person-risk KPI). SNAPSHOT-DRIVEN BY DESIGN: Phase 1 avoids live Salesforce / ServiceNow API calls at dashboard-build time (US-074 scope 1, US-078 AC 'cleanly generated at Pages-deploy'), so this file is the single source. Update by hand (or a future sync job) — each edit is a committed, auditable data point. A metric carrying a non-empty "pending" is blocked on the noted dependency and renders as 'pending', NEVER as a fabricated number. Wire to live sources once #1121 (Flow B) lands. FLOW C IS NOW LIVE (2026-09-03) and its figures below are measured, not estimated — with the test/real split stated, because most early volume was Ingrid and Halvor testing rather than genuine incidents.

key_person_risk.note: Ingrid's Matrix <-> GitHub manual sync. STILL 1 as of 2026-09-14, deliberately. The sync is live and automates creation, both-way comments and closure — but the handlers have not yet been briefed, so Ingrid is still shadowing it manually. This flips to 0 when she actually stops, which follows the team briefing rather than the technology. Reporting 0 before then would claim a dependency was removed while the person is still doing the work.
